findings.text: Five links in live code still build the flat `/framework/ai/sessions/<id>/` url (requirement 2). They are `ext/Refine/PromptView.js:96` and `:101`, `ai/rail/DashRow.js:53` (a dashboard row), `core/Page/PageInbox.js:111` and `core/Role/RoleView.js:69`. They build the url by string concatenation, so the brief's grep pattern never found them. The task log lists PromptView as "left on purpose" and uses it as the reason to keep the redirect, but requirement 2 says code that builds a flat link must build the dated one instead. Each should use `AICost.session_href(id)` (or `AISession.page_url(id)`). Once they do, the redirect decision should be checked again. The fallback in `Mention.js:113` is documented and can stay.

The census in the task log is incomplete, so a fresh agent would trust a list that misses item 1. Deliverable 1 asked for every place that builds the flat url. Add the five files above to the "Places" log line, or give the grep that finds concatenated urls (`git grep -n -E "ai/sessions/\" *\+|ai/sessions/\$\{" -- 'public/**/*.js'`).

`AICost.session_href` depends on `AISession.slugs` already being loaded. On a surface that has not scanned the index, the link falls back to the flat url and goes through the redirect. That is harmless while the redirect stays, but it is one more thing that depends on it.

findings.text: Server-side code still builds flat `/framework/ai/sessions/<uuid>/` links and writes them into committed files (requirement 2). `Server/AskIndex.mjs:47` (`AskIndex.link`, written into module inboxes at :157 and :260), `Servex/ext/refine/TagRouter.js:63` (the tag note's text), `Servex/ext/refine/CardAsk.js:39` (a card's `source`) and `Server/RefineQueue.mjs:171` (the prompt page fallback). All four run in node, where `SessionFolders.at(store).of(id)` gives the dated folder. Until they change, every new note or card adds another link that needs the redirect, and the decision to keep the redirect rests on those links.

The census in the task log still leaves out the node/Servex builders in finding 1 (and `Servex/ext/refine/VoicePage.js:37`, `page_tools.js:200` `own_page`, which pass a flat path to the page tools as input). It neither fixes them nor says they were left on purpose, so a fresh agent working from the folder alone would think the census is complete (deliverable 1). Rounds 1 and 2 grepped only `public/*.js`. A grep that also covers node: `git grep -n -E 'ai/sessions/\$\{(session|id|who|p\.session)\}/' -- Server Servex`.
